result.title: ConstraintMatch: Compositional Image-Text Matching through Constrained Regional Evidence Selection
result.summary: Local image--text matching can find strong evidence for individual concepts yet favor captions with incorrect attribute--entity bindings. We introduce ConstraintMatch, a training-free inference method that turns entity-level regional consistency into an explicit matching cost. On the same frozen condition--region similarity matrix, it compares independent crop selection for each category and attribute with a shared crop choice within each entity. Their gap quantifies the score advantage obtained by relaxing the shared-region constraint. Spatial references from the same image calibrate this gap by keeping category evidence fixed while jointly shifting an entity's attribute maps. Per-entity clipping prevents cancellation across residuals, and the scaled mean cost is subtracted from global similarity. ConstraintMatch uses pooled embeddings, and spatial calibration requires no additional encoder calls. With parameters fixed per backbone across tasks, ConstraintMatch improves over global matching by 7.70 percentage points on full ARO Attribute and 5.63 points on held-out SugarCrepe++ attribute swaps, averaged across Qwen~2B and CORE~2B. Against SGI adapted to the same 13-crop budget, the respective gains are 4.85 and 3.51 points. Controlled analyses distinguish the effects of shared-region matching and candidate score calibration. The results establish entity-level evidence selection as a practical scoring principle for compositional multimodal retrieval.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ConstraintMatch，一种无需训练的推理期打分方法：在冻结的区域—文本相似度矩阵上，比较「每个类别与属性各自独立选裁剪」与「同一实体内共享裁剪」的得分差，把实体级区域一致性转为显式的匹配代价，并用同图空间参考校准，从而改善组合式图文检索。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按实体约束筛选区域证据、并量化放松约束带来的虚假得分优势」的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选以及 latent 状态是否保留属性—实体绑定提供可供核查的线索；但该方法仅作用于冻结双塔相似度，未涉及 VLM 推理状态或生成过程。
